implementation.durable_identity: The authenticated Control request identity is bound to the Environment session, consumer, principal, campaign, full command, and target index.
implementation.intent_and_receipts: One durable intent precedes Git mutation. Each completed target has its own durable receipt; the final receipt is written after all targets complete. A replay returns the saved result and marks replayed_request.
reconciliation: A worktree is complete only when both its recorded Git registration and physical checkout are absent.
A surviving registration with a missing checkout, an unregistered surviving directory, or a changed administrative identity remains UNKNOWN and is preserved.
An interrupted branch deletion is reconciled against its original object id; Git ref deletion uses update-ref compare-and-delete.
Prune retries are restricted to the recorded Git prune candidates and protected calls run inside the exact project alias.
implementation.authority_and_provenance: The session rechecks retirement authority and Store claims before each retrying mutation. Intent and completion events record the Environment session, consumer, authenticated principal, campaign, admitted scope, exact target identity, and result.
implementation.store_boundary: Environment events use the existing Store-backed session event log. The change adds no Store filesystem access or alternate persistence database.
